sources.said: Our Lady of Sorrows Church / A Perpetual Eucharistic Adoration Parish, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week / 724 Maple Avenue, Linwood
PERPETUAL ADORATION Offer God 1 hour per week 24 Hours/Day - 7 Days a Week ... Adorers Needed: Thursday - 3:00 am
Perpetual Adoration 24 hours/day-7 Days/Week Adorers are needed.

slots.rationale: R30/R32: both bulletins and the website advertise 24/7 perpetual Adoration with an adorer roster (still seeking a Thursday 3 AM adorer), so it is current, but neither bulletin nor the site (Adorers page, homepage) says where it is held or names a chapel; POLICY leaves out a chapel whose location is unclear. Leaning include because the bulletin prints the claim directly under the parish's only church and its address, and the homepage's Holy Week notes treat Adoration as the church's own (suspended for the Triduum, resuming after the Easter Vigil). 00:00-23:59 each day is the closest the format comes to continuous Adoration.
